import json
import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Data
period_data = {
    1: {"demand": 45, "setup_cost": 261, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    2: {"demand": 22, "setup_cost": 148, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    3: {"demand": 36, "setup_cost": 133, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    4: {"demand": 34, "setup_cost": 449, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    5: {"demand": 38, "setup_cost": 141, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    6: {"demand": 20, "setup_cost": 450, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    7: {"demand": 37, "setup_cost": 329, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    8: {"demand": 35, "setup_cost": 500, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    9: {"demand": 14, "setup_cost": 367, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    10: {"demand": 29, "setup_cost": 278, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    11: {"demand": 49, "setup_cost": 296, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    12: {"demand": 45, "setup_cost": 202, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    13: {"demand": 14, "setup_cost": 169, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    14: {"demand": 24, "setup_cost": 262, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    15: {"demand": 12, "setup_cost": 135, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    16: {"demand": 26, "setup_cost": 487, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    17: {"demand": 20, "setup_cost": 244, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    18: {"demand": 38, "setup_cost": 322, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    19: {"demand": 37, "setup_cost": 388, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    20: {"demand": 17, "setup_cost": 477, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    21: {"demand": 32, "setup_cost": 410, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    22: {"demand": 20, "setup_cost": 137, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    23: {"demand": 14, "setup_cost": 100, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    24: {"demand": 22, "setup_cost": 350, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    25: {"demand": 45, "setup_cost": 483, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
}

capacity = {
    1: 67, 2: 23, 3: 29, 4: 52, 5: 49, 6: 14, 7: 43, 8: 33, 9: 13, 10: 41,
    11: 41, 12: 49, 13: 12, 14: 33, 15: 8, 16: 30, 17: 25, 18: 33, 19: 37, 20: 24,
    21: 37, 22: 27, 23: 20, 24: 27, 25: 64
}

T = sorted(period_data.keys())

# Model
model = gp.Model("single_item_lot_sizing_cap")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Variables
x = model.addVars(T, lb=0.0, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="production")
y = model.addVars(T, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="setup")
I = model.addVars(T, lb=0.0, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="inventory")

# Constraints
for t in T:
    if t == 1:
        model.addConstr(x[t] == period_data[t]["demand"] + I[t], name=f"balance_{t}")
    else:
        model.addConstr(I[t - 1] + x[t] == period_data[t]["demand"] + I[t], name=f"balance_{t}")
    model.addConstr(x[t] <= capacity[t] * y[t], name=f"capacity_setup_{t}")

# Objective
obj = gp.quicksum(
    period_data[t]["setup_cost"] * y[t]
    + period_data[t]["prod_cost"] * x[t]
    + period_data[t]["holding_cost"] * I[t]
    for t in T
)
model.setObjective(obj, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Solve
model.optimize()

# Output
production_solution = {str(t): x[t].X for t in T}
result = {
    "production": production_solution,
    "objective_value": model.ObjVal
}
print(json.dumps(result))
